query: Consider FullStory's Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold: 6. This Agreement will become effective as of the Effective Date and will continue until the date one party receives written notice of termination of this Agreement from the other party; provided, however, that a Recipient’s obligations under Section 2 will survive termination of this Agreement and will continue with respect to the Discloser’s Confidential Information until the obligations no longer apply pursuant to Section 3 above.
rag_answer: Yes. The document states that a Recipient’s obligations under Section 2 will survive termination of the Agreement and will continue with respect to the Discloser’s Confidential Information until those obligations no longer apply under Section 3.

judge.gold_summary: 金标说明协议在收到书面终止通知后终止，但接收方在第2条下的义务会在协议终止后继续存续，并针对披露方的保密信息持续适用，直到根据第3条不再适用。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答称文档确实提及接收方在第2条下的义务会在协议终止后存续，并针对披露方保密信息继续适用，直到根据第3条不再适用。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键结论：协议终止后部分义务仍存续，且具体对应第2条义务、第3条终止适用条件，判断为命中。
